verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair question to ask of a game engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows Bevy is code-first: systems are "normal Rust functions" and components are Rust structs. Nothing in the pack documents a visual scripting or node-based gameplay logic tool, and a community member notes the engine lacks an editor like Godot's.

support.subject: As a technical artist, I can build gameplay logic with visual scripting without writing code
